name: Keystone Championship
epitaph: A singles title, defended on SLAM and at the pay-per-views and 'open challenged' by its holders; its holders include Derecho (2013), Judasbleek (2014), Ali Amore (2016 and 2017), Max Hopper (2017), Alex Reyn (2018 and 2019), Rey de los Diamantes (2019) and Jake Tockwell (2019).

name: Blitzkrieg Championship
epitaph: A singles title of the hardcore style, held by Judasbleek (2013 and 2014), Benjamin Jones, Eric Yulan, Brock Newbludd, Jake Tockwell, Ohiyama, Chris Smith, VIP, Big Rick Strongbern and Jonny Bedlam.

name: Dynasty Tag Team Championships
epitaph: The fed's tag titles, whose first holders in the held posts are the Dynasty Cup's champions of 2013; later holders include Sons of Evolution, A-List, Clan Strongbern and The House.

name: Infamy Championship
epitaph: A singles title held by Techno Dragon, Son of Malta, Benjamin Jones and Eric Yulan in the held posts.

name: World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's top singles title, held in the held posts by Vic Gravender, Saphire, Chris Moliano, Derecho, Warren Spade, Jake Tockwell, Brock Newbludd, Pat Gordon Jr and Jonny Bedlam.
